checklist: make --version is GNU Make 4.4.1 (cert/make.mjs, as a non-root user under users enforce)
make -n prints the recipe without running it; make -q exits 1 before the build and 0 after

a Makefile with a pattern rule, $< $@ $^, $(wildcard), $(patsubst), $(notdir), an order-only directory prerequisite and a command-line variable builds out/all.txt with the expected content, running cp, echo, cat and mkdir through the shell
a second make does nothing; a new source rebuilds only its own output; an unknown target exits 2 with 'No rule to make target'; make clean removes out/
